tools.name: take_demo_screenshot
tools.description: See what a localscreenshot result looks like: a real screenshot of one of our example pages. It does not capture a page of your choice. For that, create a free account and use the main MCP server with an API key.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List the countries a screenshot can be taken from, with their two-letter codes. Choosing a country needs an account: this free endpoint only lists them.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: What localscreenshot costs: the free credits every account gets each month, the limits of a free account, what a screenshot costs in credits, and where paid plans and credit packs start.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "What localscreenshot costs: the free credits of a new account, its limits, what a screenshot costs in credits, and where paid plans and credit packs start." → after: "What localscreenshot costs: the free credits every account gets each month, the limits of a free account, what a screenshot costs in credits, and where paid plans and credit packs start."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
